{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Infobox Location |name = Ardougne |image = [[File:Ardougne.png]] |release = [[30 April]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (30 April 2002) |members = Yes |location = [[Kandarin]] |race = [[Human]]s |teleport = {{*}} [[Ardougne Teleport]]
{{*}} [[West Ardougne Teleport]]
{{*}} [[Fairy rings]] ({{Fairycode|DJP}}) |diary = [[Ardougne Diary]] |map = {{Map|name=Ardougne|zoom=0|x=2570|y=3300}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} [[File:Ardougne icon detail.png|left|130px]] '''Ardougne''' ({{IPAc-en|jagex|ɑːr|ˈ|d|ɔɪ|n|audio=En-uk-Ardougne.ogg}} {{respell|arr|DOYN}}[[rsw:Transcript:Pronunciation guide#A|Pronunciation Guide]]) is the [[capital]] city of the Kingdom of [[Kandarin]]. It is divided into [[East Ardougne]] and [[West Ardougne]]. West Ardougne is closed off to the general public because of a mysterious "plague" affecting the inhabitants, but you can slowly gain complete access by completing the first few quests of the [[Plague City]] quest line. ==Transportation== *[[Ardougne Teleport]] - requires level 51 [[Magic]] and completion of the [[Plague City]] quest. *[[West Ardougne Teleport]] - requires level 51 [[Magic]] and completion of the [[Biohazard]] quest. *[[Spirit tree]] (Battlefield of Khazard) south-west of the city below the south wall of [[West Ardougne]]. *[[Captain Barnaby]]'s ship to and from [[Brimhaven]], [[Rimmington]], and [[East Ardougne]]. *[[Ardougne Monastery]] using an [[Ardougne cloak 1]] or better. *The [[farming patch]] east of the [[Fishing Guild]] using an [[Ardougne cloak 2]] or better. ==History== The area now known as Ardougne was once ruled by the [[Mahjarrat]] lord [[Hazeel]]. At some point, [[Kandarin|Kandarian]] [[Saradomin]]ists led by the [[Carnillean family]] challenged his rule and stormed his [[Carnillean Mansion|residence]], defeating the [[Zamorak]]ins within. The Carnillean forefathers then claimed the abandoned residence as their own and established a settlement from which they began building the city of Ardougne.{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 7)|quote=Using the power of runes, Saradominist humans in Kandarin, led by the Carnillean family, became confident and decided to take on the evil influences resident in the area around what is now know as Ardougne. Of particular note was an evil lord by the name of Hazeel, so they stormed his home and defeated the Zamorakins inside. The following morning, the Carnillean forefathers moved into the empty household and claimed it as their own. From this base the Carnilleans began to build the city of Ardougne.}} ===The Ardignas dynasty=== By the [[Fifth Age]], Ardougne had become the seat of power of [[Kandarin]], under the rule of the [[Ardignas]] dynasty. During the reign of [[King Ulthas Ardignas]], [[King Arthur]] and the [[Knights of the Round Table]] were granted land in north-east Kandarin, where they founded [[Camelot]].{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 9)|quote=5th Age - Year 132
King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table arrive on Gielinor in the year 132 of the 5th Age. Legend says they will return to Britain in its time of greatest need, so they're passing their time on Gielinor until then. King Ulthas saw them as good and rightful men who would do much good in the world, and granted them a large area of land to set up a new Camelot in north-east Kandarin.}} Ulthas died in 136 from an accidental arrow wound during a hunting expedition. In accordance with his wishes, his sons [[King Lathas]] and [[King Tyras]] divided his kingdom between them, splitting Ardougne into two separate territories. Lathas took control of [[East Ardougne]], while Tyras became ruler of [[West Ardougne]].{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 47)|quote=5th Age - yr 136
King Ulthas of Ardougne dies from an accidental arrow shot while out on a hunting expedition. Ardougne is left to his 2 sons, Tyras and Lathas who decide to split the city between them.}} ===Rise and fall of King Lathas=== Following Tyras's departure on an expedition beyond the [[Galarpos Mountains]], much of his kingdom's administration was left in the hands of City Warder [[Bravek]]. Sometime after Tyras's departure, Lathas formed an alliance with the [[Iorwerth Clan]] of elves, who sought access to the human lands to further their plans involving the [[Dark Lord]]. In exchange for their assistance in overthrowing the rulers of Camelot, Lathas allowed the elves to establish a presence in West Ardougne.{{CiteNPC|npc=Essyllt|quote=Now to keep our presence in the city secret, Lord Iorwerth arranged an alliance with King Lathas, the ruler in the east. Apparently the fool thinks we will help him dispose of the Knights of Camelot once our work here is done. I expect he'll be disappointed. Anyway, the plague serves two purposes. First, it allows us to move around the city in secret thanks to our mourner disguises. Second, it means we can abduct citizens to mine the caves below with ease. We just pretend they've fallen victim to the plague.|name=}} West Ardougne was subsequently enclosed by a large wall, isolating it from the outside world. The elves, disguised as [[Mourner]]s, spread rumours of a deadly plague and fabricated symptoms to maintain the deception.{{CiteNPC|npc=Essyllt|loc=Mourning's End Part I|quote=One of the things we do to keep up the lie is to fool old Farmer Brumty into believing his sheep are infected. The old halfwit thinks just because his sheep are an abnormal colour, that they are all ill with plague. It's amazing what a bit of dye can do.}} Citizens believed that those infected were being taken away for treatment, when in reality they were being abducted and forced to work in the underground mines beneath the city. The deception surrounding the plague eventually came to light, and Lathas was publicly executed at the [[Ardougne Market]]. His cousin [[King Thoros]] was subsequently appointed as the new king of Kandarin. ==East Ardougne== {{Main|East Ardougne}} [[East Ardougne]] is most popular for its marketplace, which is home to many stalls loaded with baked goods, [[silk]], [[silver]], [[fur]], [[spice]], and [[gems]]. Many players train their [[Thieving]] here. Ardougne is also home to many [[Guard]]s, [[Hero]]es, and [[Paladin]]s to pickpocket, plus two [[bank]]s, a prayer [[altar]], a [[Range|cooking range]], a [[furnace]], and several [[water]] sources. A port in Ardougne can take you to [[Brimhaven]] and a wizard to the north-east of the city can teleport you to the [[Rune essence mine]]s. There is also a [[Ardougne Zoo|zoo]] where players may start the [[Eagles' Peak]] and [[Cold War]] quests. Ardougne is also the closest major city to the [[Legends' Guild]]. Ardougne is the starting location for numerous quests, such as [[Plague City]] and its numerous sequels. South of Ardougne is a [[Ardougne Monastery|monastery]] ([[Monk's Friend]] start), the [[Tower of Life (building)|Tower of Life]], the [[Necromancer's Tower]], and the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]]. North-west of Ardougne is the [[Outpost]], where you start [[Making History]]. ===Agility Course=== Players with 90 [[Agility]] can use the [[Ardougne Rooftop Course|rooftop course]], by climbing the wooden beams near the house closest to the gem stall. The course finishes next to a crate directly south of the gem stall. It is currently the highest level course in the game. ===Banks=== Ardougne's banks are located near the north farm and the east of the zoo. They are very distinct buildings and are often convenient to use. * [[Ardougne north bank]] * [[Ardougne south bank]] ==West Ardougne== {{Main|West Ardougne}} [[West Ardougne]] contains an altar, and an [[anvil]], though it has no bank. Civilians will trade you 100 [[Death rune]]s for your fully-grown [[cat]]s (200 if the [[Ardougne Diary|easy Ardougne diary]] is completed). The entrance to the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] is at the west end. It is also influential in the quests [[Mourning's End Part I]] and [[Mourning's End Part II]]. During the [[Biohazard]] quest, and in the Mourning's End quests, you may access the building in the north-east with the range and [[sink]], although using those in East Ardougne is suggested. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 24 September 2015 |update = New Animations & Barbarian Assault Changes |change = Removed a levitating mast from the ship in Ardougne. }} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2015 |update = Boss Room Counters & Platinum Tokens |change = The [[Ardougne Elite Diary]] rewards now give increased [[Mark of Grace|Marks of Grace]] on the [[Ardougne Rooftop Course|Ardougne rooftop agility course]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 March 2015 |update = Achievement Diaries |poll = Old School Achievement Diary Rewards Poll |change = You now receive 25% (previously 50%) more marks of grace from the [[Ardougne Rooftop Course|Ardougne rooftop agility course]] if you have completed the [[Ardougne Elite Diary]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 10 December 2014 |update = The Trading Post |change = The poll booth in Ardougne south bank has been returned. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *Paul Gower has stated that the name Ardougne was inspired by the French city of Boulogne, as the city was originally planned to have a 'French vibe' and be 'the Paris of RuneScape'.{{CiteVideo|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qzykpW1loWE&t=2879s|title=BS Podcast with Paul Gower!!: Ep.23 - May 29, 2021|timestamp=00:47:59|date=2021-05-31|author=Excl Videos|site=youtube.com}} *The name Ardougne may also reference Ardoyne Road in Belfast, known for dividing Protestants and Catholics. In Belfast, a peace wall separates communities, similar to that of the wall dividing East and West Ardougne. *According to a god letter, Ardougne has a football team called the [[Ardougne Chimeras]]. *Ardougne is named after the [[River Dougne]], which flows through the city directly east of [[Ardougne Castle]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1587394826894450688|date=01 November 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109609|archivedate=01 November 2022|quote=I believe the city was named after the river that flows through it, and the river's name is indeed pronounced like the city.}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{East Ardougne}} {{West Ardougne}} [[Category:Ardougne]] [[Category:Kandarin]]
